description: Source code for the NodeAffinity plugin in Kubernetes scheduler framework, implementing filtering, scoring, and node affinity logic for pod scheduling.

classes.name: NodeAffinity
classes.description: Implements Kubernetes scheduler plugin for node affinity filtering and scoring.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the plugin name used in registry and configs.

methods.name: SignPod
methods.description: Generates signing fragments for the pod's node affinity.

methods.name: EventsToRegister
methods.description: Returns events that may make a pod schedulable after node changes.

methods.name: isSchedulableAfterNodeChange
methods.description: Determines if a node change makes a pod schedulable.

methods.name: PreFilter
methods.description: Builds and writes cycle state for filtering based on node affinity.

methods.name: PreFilterExtensions
methods.description: Returns nil as no extensions are needed.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Checks if a node matches pod affinity and added node selector.

methods.name: PreScore
methods.description: Builds and writes cycle state for scoring based on node affinity.

methods.name: Score
methods.description: Calculates score for a node based on affinity terms.

methods.name: NormalizeScore
methods.description: Normalizes node scores after scoring all nodes.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Initializes a new NodeAffinity plugin instance.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Parses plugin arguments from runtime object.

methods.name: getPodPreferredNodeAffinity
methods.description: Retrieves preferred node affinity terms from pod spec.

methods.name: getPreScoreState
methods.description: Reads pre-score state from cycle state.

methods.name: getPreFilterState
methods.description: Reads pre-filter state from cycle state.
